channel.title: Nicotine Science and Policy
channel.description: Daily digest of views, debates and discussions on nicotine science, policy, regulation and advocacy.

item.title: Belgium postpones terrace smoking ban
item.description: Belgium has postponed its planned ban on smoking and vaping on café and restaurant terraces, originally scheduled for January 2027, following objections from the Council of State and concerns raised by the hospitality sector. (Published on October 27, 2026bypolitico.eu)

item.title: Four times Sweden's tax: inside the EU's new plan for nicotine pouches
item.description: The EU's latest tobacco tax proposal could introduce a minimum excise duty on nicotine pouches more than four times Sweden's current rate by 2032. (Published on October 27, 2026byconsideratepouchers.org)

item.title: Ireland vape flavour restrictions clear final Seanad stage
item.description: Ireland's proposed vape flavour restrictions have cleared their final Seanad stages, despite warnings from retailers and former smokers about their potential consequences. (Published on October 27, 2026byclearingtheair.eu)

item.title: Smokeless products: Science doesn't wait for policy.
item.description: Scientific research on smoke-free nicotine products continues to advance, even in countries where these products face restrictions or outright bans. (Published on October 27, 2026byvietnam.vn)
